method: Visual inspection of raw sampled frames, processed cycles and actual 43-to-0 wrap strips, supported by native-resolution metrics. Browser animation playback was not observed by the agent.

lantern-pixel.summary: Blue flame changes shape inside a mostly steady metal frame; automatic masking preserves the open gaps. Metal highlights still vary and the wrap is more noticeable than the knight's. Prefer nearest 128px; 64px remains recognizable but loses flame detail.

knight-control.summary: Recognizable knight and stable feet, but restrained cape motion and a more noticeable change in armor highlights at the wrap. Fine details vary. Prefer 128px nearest to either 64px version.

knight-pixel.summary: Clearer breathing poses: shoulders and sword rise and settle, with stable feet and a closer loop boundary. Best simple knight candidate at 128px nearest + ENDESGA. Armor highlights and small gauntlet details still need review.

wraith-pixel.summary: The body rises and falls with moving robe tails. Fine ribs, hands and cyan highlights vary, making this noisier than the knight. Prefer 128px nearest; Pyxelate blurs the skull and bone details.

knight-pixel-loop.summary: Keeps the breathing motion and has a close wrap. Ending-frame conditioning adds little improvement over the ordinary pixel-adapter run in this seed; it is not a demonstrated general loop fix.
